course.title: MongoDB — Complete Deep Database Course
course.description: A database-specific, beginner-to-advanced MongoDB course covering data modeling, querying, integrity, performance, security, operations and a complete learning-platform database capstone.
course.curriculumPolicy: Module and lesson counts are determined by the database concepts required to learn the technology properly; no fixed template is imposed.
learningOutcomes: Handle transactions or atomic operations where applicable.
Integrate the database with backend APIs.
Build a complete learning-platform data layer.

modules.title: MongoDB Foundations
modules.description: Understand document databases, collections, documents, BSON and when MongoDB is a good fit.

lessons.title: MongoDB Foundations
lessons.description: Understand document databases, collections, documents, BSON and when MongoDB is a good fit.
learningObjectives: Apply it to a realistic learning-platform scenario.

notes.text: Understand document databases, collections, documents, BSON and when MongoDB is a good fit.

Understand mongodb foundations first as a data problem, then learn the database-specific syntax. The goal is to know what the database is doing, why the design works, and what trade-offs appear at scale.
MongoDB Foundations is important when building real applications because database decisions affect correctness, performance, reliability and maintainability.

notes.caption: Teaching diagram for MongoDB Foundations: show the data flow and important database operations.

items: Trace what happens internally at a high level.
Identify the data being stored or retrieved.
Change one part and test again.
Using a data model without considering access patterns.
Treating production databases like local development databases.
I can explain MongoDB Foundations in my own words.
I can implement a small example.
I can identify an edge case.
I can explain one performance or reliability consideration.

practicals.objective: Apply MongoDB Foundations in a controlled MongoDB exercise.
